A data row with more cells than the header widens the separator so no cell is silently dropped

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<table><tr><th>A</th><th>B</th></tr><tr><td>1</td><td>2</td><td>3</td></tr></table>", ConversionOptions())
    println(result)
}
```
